text_block_list.text:
One day, hearing that a "Local Gourmet 
Festival" was being held at an outdoor 
venue, I went to take a look—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Have you also arrived at this 
grand battlefield of rival warlords!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indubitably! Renowned delicacies from all 
over the country gathered in one place, 
vying for supremacy. What else could you 
call this if not a battlefield!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems you are too late! As for 
me, I have already devoured every food 
stall, unifying the realm within my belly—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what is that? There is a stall 
way out on the fringes—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Let's give up, Furioso-kun. My luck with 
the booth lottery was just too awful...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't, Shopkeeper. You can't be so 
faint-hearted.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
But nobody's gonna come all the way out 
here. Damn it—and here we had a chance to 
introduce the taste of Funabashi to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Shopkeeper...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, I will not give up! No matter how 
disadvantaged our location is, no matter 
how formidable the rivals arrayed against 
us!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Upon my love and pride for Funabashi, I 
swear! I will make the entire venue aware 
of this—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The flavor of Funabashi Sauce Ramen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now that is the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: kh!? You are...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To set your sights on ruling the realm 
from such a barren outpost—truly, you 
possess the boldness to wrestle tigers and 
cross raging rivers bare-handed.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, however. I like you. In that 
case, allow me to lend you a hand!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I am touched by your concern. However, 
this is a matter of Funabashi's prestige, 
so I must decline any outside assistance—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: How preposterous!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
With the realm within reach, why fuss over 
such petty trivialities! Show the grit to 
exploit every single thing at your 
disposal!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Do so, and the path forward shall open on 
its own. Now watch closely—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye, those far away, listen 
to my voice!! Those nearby, step forward 
and behold with your own eyes~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Behold Funabashi's specialty, "Sauce 
Ramen"!! The one destined to conquer this 
entire Gourmet Festival!

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendees
text_block_list.text:
—What's that voice? Where's it coming 
from? —Did she say sauce ramen? Shall we 
check it out?

Hearing the booming sales pitch, customers 
from all over the venue began flocking 
over!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
~~~kh. Is this... the conquering spirit of 
the "Central"?

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendees
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, there was a stall all the way out 
here? —Wait, sauce ramen? I've never heard 
of that before!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, don't just stand there dazed, 
pitch it! Now is your moment!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! ...This is Funabashi's proud ramen, 
crafted with Worcestershire sauce in the 
broth! Please, take a taste!
choice_data_list:
Incredible, there's a huge line forming in 
no time—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, this is merely the beginning. Did I 
not say to exploit everything?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Now listen well, my retainers gathered 
there!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I am No Reason! I wish to spread the glory 
of this ramen across the entire realm! Are 
there any wise minds among you willing to 
assist?!

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh~, that came out of nowhere... Well, 
it really is delicious, so maybe I'll 
recommend it to my friends later!

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll post it on Umastagram! The sauce 
ramen is a whole new taste and super 
tasty!

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendee C
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking Umatok~. We should probably 
align our hashtags, right? Since we're 
doing it, maybe we can get it trending?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Umu. Word of mouth and social spread, 
excellent indeed! Now, my retainers, exert 
yourselves to your heart's content!!

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, this feels like a school festival, 
it's getting fun! My Lord! Spreading the 
word on sauce ramen, right away sire!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's spreading... the taste of Funabashi 
is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Please forgive my lack of foresight, No 
Reason-san. Without you, such a result 
would never—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. In the first place, 
it was because I acknowledged your 
fighting spirit. More importantly—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is unification of the realm! 
Everyone, show your might!!
(OOOOOOOO~~~~!!!!)

And so, under No Reason's brilliant 
command—the Funabashi Sauce Ramen 
brilliantly won the Gourmet Festival Gold 
Prize!
